code:
Before: 100 ETH / 200,000 USDC, 1,000 LP tokens outstanding
You deposit: 5 ETH + 10,000 USDC (5% of each reserve)
Pool mints you: 1,000 * 0.05 = 50 LP tokens

After: 105 ETH / 210,000 USDC, 1,050 LP tokens outstanding
Your share: 50 / 1,050 = 4.76% of the pool
caption: The contract requires deposits to match the current reserve ratio.

eyebrow: Fees accrue into the pool itself
code:
Every trade's fee stays in the reserves (not paid out separately)
  -> k grows slightly with every trade
  -> your % share stays the same, but the pool grows
  -> burn your LP tokens later = redeem your share of that growth
caption: Fee income shows up as pool growth, not a separate payout.

titlePlain: You may not get back what you put
